name: microchip-fpga-soc
description: Microchip PolarFire SoC family development: Libero SoC headless flows, SmartHLS kernel authoring/pragmas, SmartDebug Active-Probe, FlashPro6/OpenOCD JTAG mechanics and hygiene. Spans the PolarFire SoC family (MPFS250T, MPFS095T, etc.) -- not tied to one exact die.
